 Six photos of a "FAST FAFSA" event at Knapp Elementary
 James Akakpo, from left, Lizeth Brito, Elizabeth Erickson, Donta Buckles, Davion Robinson, Allan Sanchez, Claudia Dieck, Alexis Kleihauer and Alejandro Solis were some of the attendees at a FAFSA workshop July 17 at Knapp Elementary. There are five additional free workshops over the next few weeks: two in Racine and three in Kenosha.
 SUBMITTED
 Kimberly Melendez, left, receives help with her FAFSA form from Alejandro Solis, one of four financial aid support team members, during a workshop Wednesday at Knapp Elementary.
 Ryan Patterson
 Alexis Kleihauer, right, assists Donta Buckles, who attends Texas Southern University, with his FAFSA form during a workshop Wednesday at Knapp Elementary, 2701 17th St. Kleihauer is one of four financial aid support team members assisting Racine and Kenosha students complete their FAFSA forms this summer.
 Ryan Patterson
 Alexis Kleihauer, left, helps James Akakpo, who attends Clark Atlanta University, with his FAFSA form during a workshop Wednesday at Knapp Elementary. Billions of dollars go unused every year across the country because people do not fill out FAFSA forms, so Kleihauer and team members are trying to increase the completion rate among area residents.
 Ryan Patterson
